scale_cues: I used the large square white dinner plate, about 27-28 cm across, as the main size reference. The green beans are about 10-12 cm long and the chicken drumstick is about 13 cm long including the bone.
assumptions: I took the chicken to be a single drumstick (it could be a small leg quarter). The skin is included and the bone is excluded.
I estimated the rice mound at about 0.75 cup, judging from its height and spread.
The arugula looks undressed. If there is a vinaigrette, add about 5-10 g of dressing.
The small herb flecks on the chicken weigh under 5 g, so I merged them into the chicken item.
I assumed about 5 g of oil from roasting and from tossing the beans.
